verdict.rationale: Cross-tool task aggregation is a fair question for a project-management product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows GitHub Projects viewing and grouping GitHub's own issues, pull requests and draft issues by assignee. The GraphQL API and Actions are developer building blocks for constructing such a view, not a documented ability to pull tasks from other project management tools into one unified view.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
